verdict.rationale: BigCommerce does list a dedicated payments page ('Ecommerce Payment Providers & Credit Card Solutions') suggesting an integrated payments offering (BigCommerce Payments), but the evidence pack contains only the page title/URL with no detail on published card rates, payout schedules, or fraud tooling specifics. Missing for 10: documented rate cards, payout timing details, fraud/chargeback tooling specifics, and independent/hands-on confirmation that merchants can process payments without a third-party gateway.
